name: Krab-M1

cost.display: Domestic production, unit cost not publicly disclosed

characteristics: Strength: Automated target-recognition assist for anti-tank use is unusual among the smaller Ukrainian combat UGVs
Limitation: Small chassis limits payload/armor compared to larger platforms
Estimated quantity available: Fielded numbers not publicly disclosed
employment_notes: One of several parallel Ukrainian combat UGV designs (alongside Ironclad and Moroz), reflecting a deliberately decentralized, many-small-vendors approach to ground robotics rather than one standardized platform
contrast_vs_traditional: Like Ironclad, Krab-M1 is a remotely operated fire-support platform built to take the highest-risk seconds of close engagement away from a human crew — the same doctrine.md-documented shift toward unmanned platforms absorbing the exposure that traditional assault doctrine put on infantry directly.

notes: Written from doctrine.md and general knowledge; no per-asset citation yet.
